features.title: Big stories need a clear foundation.
features.intro: You shape the characters and the story. Hetu organizes the canon, revisions and delivery. External agents can assist; you make the decisions.

workflow.title: From the first chapter to the next medium.
workflow.intro: Share canon across the original and its adaptations. Keep drafts and approved work distinct. Work entirely by hand or connect an external agent when useful.

steps.title: Build your story bible
steps.body: Maintain characters, locations, factions and timelines. Discovered entities remain suggestions until you confirm them.

steps.title: Write and adapt
steps.body: Write chapters, organize existing plot beats, then outline episodes and scenes. The core structures material; it does not invent dialogue.

steps.title: Check and review
steps.body: Inspect source evidence. Handle deterministic conflicts and advisory findings separately, then decide what to approve.

steps.title: Version and deliver
steps.body: Create Git snapshots and optionally sync to GitHub or Gitee. Export fixed revisions in the recipient’s format.

details.title: Suggestions are not canon
details.body: Discovered names, places and relationships remain candidates. Only author-confirmed content enters the story bible.

details.title: Checks are not literary judges
details.body: Rules inspect explicit facts and structure, reporting coverage and uncertainty. Motivation and literary choices stay with the author.

details.title: Approval is not autosave
details.body: Review binds an exact draft, canon and report revision. Changed inputs require new checks; previous decisions remain in history.

details.title: Export is not publication
details.body: Bundles are saved locally. You review content, rights statements and recipient requirements; files are not uploaded automatically.

open.title: The tools keep it together. The story is yours.
open.body: No built-in models or generation-service lock-in. Readable files, Git history and open MCP let you choose your own creative process.

integrations.title: Agents assist. Authors decide.
integrations.intro: External agents such as Codex and WorkBuddy use local MCP to read authorized canon and submit drafts. Hetu handles constraints and workflow, without built-in models or generation APIs.

layers.title: Story bible and rules
layers.body: Author-confirmed canon is the baseline. Agents cannot unlock or rewrite canon, or approve their own drafts.

layers.title: MCP tools and resources
layers.body: Canon reads, draft submission, plot extraction, scene outlines, validation and export share core authorization and transactions.

layers.title: Codex plugins and AXI
layers.body: Plugins distribute workflows and connections. AXI shapes machine receipts and original-operation recovery. Neither keeps another source of story facts.

integrations.status: Integration claims depend on exact protocol and host versions, with verification evidence. Installing a plugin does not grant full file or Git access.
integrations.manual: A complete workflow without an agent
integrations.manualBody: Manual writing, story-bible maintenance, rule checks, review, local snapshots and export belong to the core. External agents are optional assistance.

formats.title: Editable for authors. Readable for recipients.
formats.body: Novels use Markdown; scripts use Fountain. Export TXT, DOCX or PDF through recipient profiles, with conversion losses and provenance recorded. File standards, writing conventions and production templates remain distinct.

faq.title: Know the boundaries before you begin.

items.q: Will Hetu write my novel for me?
items.a: No. The core contains no model or generation API. It organizes canon, storage, extraction, validation, review and delivery. Write manually or choose your own external agent.

items.q: Can an agent change my story bible?
items.a: Managed interfaces do not let agents change canon, unlock it or approve their own drafts. Locks control the authoring workflow. Other programs still operate under OS file permissions; Hetu does not claim absolute isolation.

items.q: Will consistency checks detect every out-of-character moment?
items.a: No. Deterministic checks require explicit facts and structure. Complex motivation, personality and expression receive source-backed advisories with coverage and uncertainty. Authors make the final judgment.

items.q: Which platforms and languages are included?
items.a: V1 is designed for native macOS on Apple Silicon and Windows 11 x64, with a shared Swift CLI. Simplified Chinese comes first, with full English support. This site offers both languages; mobile visuals are extensions only.
The application is in development. This site provides user guides and an interactive prototype, which does not access a real workspace. Follow the source repository for code and progress.

items.q: Will my work be uploaded or become open source?
items.a: Author IP workspaces are separate from the software repository. The core runs locally, without collecting manuscripts or uploading by default. Remote Git and external agents require explicit selection and authorization.

items.q: How do I deliver a novel or script?
items.a: Keep Markdown or Fountain sources and fixed revisions, then export formats such as TXT, DOCX and PDF through recipient profiles. Bundles also record canon, diagnostics, versions and provenance.

items.q: What are the license and costs?
items.a: The core repository uses Apache-2.0. Multimedia routing is a separate optional plugin direction, with providers chosen by users. The core has no compute billing or generation-service dependency.
